The '''Grand Terminal''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located in [[Junction City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]]. At the center of the spaceport, there was a large staircase called the [[Great Stair]], which decended to the port's various [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]]. At some point between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a bagman for the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]] traveled to the Grand Terminal while transporting some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|funds]] that Taug was sending to the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Thanda clan]]. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were tracking the movement of Taug's funds staked out the Great Stair and they followed the bagman to [[Docking Bay 112]], where the bagman and the spacers boarded a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was due to travel to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Bazarre]].
